div.div: مُجَشَّرٌ [A beast] made to pass the night in the pasture, away from its owner, not brought back in the evening: (K, * TA: [see also جَشَرٌ:]) or not pastured near the water: (IAar, TA:) or that is pastured near to the water. (El-Mundhiree, TA.) And خَيْلٌ مُجَشَّرَةٌ Horses pastured (S, K) بِالحِمَى [in the place of pasturage that is prohibited to the public]. (S.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
